messages:
Noah (Finance): FYI seeing a spike in micro-claim chargebacks tied to vendor 'QuickPay Integrations' on payouts scheduled today. 27 disputes in 48h totaling EUR 1,290. Opening thread to coordinate hold + evidence.
Lea (Payments): Do we have gateway tx ids? Is this on Stripe or PSP?
Noah (Finance): Mostly Stripe. Sample tx ids: tx_a12f, tx_a13b, tx_a14c. Merchant descriptor shows 'QuickPay*Invoice' but customer dispute text says 'unauthorized small charges'.
Omar (Risk): Pattern: small amounts (EUR 10-70), different cardholders but same BIN cluster and similar timezone. Could be a subscription token reuse attack.
Priya (Partner Ops): QuickPay pays out twice weekly. Payout today is EUR 42,000. Recommend holding the entire payout to triage. @Hana any cashflow concerns?
Hana (Accounting): Holding will affect revenue recognition for the partner but doable. Need a journal hold code and reserve line. Please confirm amount to reserve.
Noah (Finance): Reserve EUR 2,000 to be safe. We'll reconcile after dispute outcomes. Creating JE now.
Lea (Payments): I'll flag the vendor's Stripe account and pause payouts. Also submitting disputes evidence where we have receipts. But micro-claims are hard to defend.
VendorOps Bot: Automated notice sent to vendor contact quickpay.ops@vendor.com with subject: "Immediate payout hold - suspicious chargebacks".
Priya (Partner Ops): I just DM'd QuickPay. They claim full KYC passed last quarter. Requesting transaction logs and customer contact list.
Omar (Risk): Can ops run a query for similar descriptors in last 7 days?
Priya (Partner Ops): Running:
```
select created_at, tx_id, amount, bin, country from payments where descriptor ilike '%QuickPay%' and created_at > now() - interval '7 days';
```
Result: 82 rows, 39 flagged as disputed, majority EU.
Lea (Payments): We should prepare an evidence bundle for the bank: merchant invoice, signed order confirmations, webhook receipts, email receipts, IPs. For micro-transactions, consumer receipts often missing.
Noah (Finance): Also loop Legal: if vendor is absorbing fraud risk per contract, we may clawback. Attach contract snippet.
Hana (Accounting): I added reserve line CR 1200-Reserve, DR 4300-Expense. Notified GL owners.
Omar (Risk): Quick mitigation: add rule to block repeat BINs and require 3DS for descriptors matching '%QuickPay%'. Priya can we throttle or require stronger auth on partner routes?
Priya (Partner Ops): We can flip a partner-level flag to enforce 3DS and block card-on-file charges for 24h. Pushing to staging now.
Lea (Payments): Evidence footprint: sample webhook for tx_a12f pasted to shared drive (link: https://redwood.internal/payments/evidence/tx_a12f). Include full customer email header and order id.
Noah (Finance): Good. Also need to notify Sales/AMs; QuickPay is a reseller. We'll need to pause co-marketing until this clears. @Priya handle comms.
Priya (Partner Ops): Will notify AM and send vendor freeze notice.
dispute-bot: Automated update - 27 disputes created between 2026-03-24 and 2026-03-26. Next response deadlines vary per card network.
VendorOps Bot: Vendor replied: "We're investigating; sending transaction logs and signed customer orders." ETA 4h.
Omar (Risk): If vendor can't show signed customer consent for >60% of the disputed txs, escalate to card network for fraud investigation.
Hana (Accounting): Confirmed reserve posted. Will reclassify after chargeback outcomes.
Lea (Payments): I'll prepare the partial evidence submission to Stripe and set the holds. If bank rules in favor of cardholders, we'll pursue vendor recovery per contract.
Noah (Finance): Thanks all. Quick checklist: 1) Payout hold (Lea) 2) Reserve posted (Hana) 3) Evidence bundle (Lea/Priya) 4) Vendor KYC re-review + contract (Priya/Legal) 5) Short-term auth rule (Omar). Meeting in 45 to review vendor logs.
Priya (Partner Ops): Meeting invite sent.
Noah (Finance): Closing thread for now; keep updates here.
